description:
Cap Rocat is a former Spanish military fortress, carefully restored and converted into a beachfront luxury hotel in the Bay of Palma de Mallorca. Guests describe the experience as "walking inside history": the fort's original walls remain visible in the lobby and much of the property, combined with contemporary luxury design. It is a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World and holds Biosphere sustainability certification.

Today its Double Rooms, Suites (including suites with a private pool), and Superior Suites with sea views all have a private balcony.

The fortress's origins as a genuine 19th-century Spanish military installation, with its original walls left visible rather than concealed by the renovation, give Cap Rocat a documented military architectural heritage distinct from decorative castle-style hotels.

As the second Mallorca property in this collection, alongside Son Vida Castle, Cap Rocat represents the first military fortress converted into a beachfront luxury hotel here, distinguishing it from the more traditional inland manor-castle format.

The property's Biosphere sustainability certification, alongside its Small Luxury Hotels of the World membership, gives Cap Rocat a formally recognized environmental credential alongside its luxury positioning.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In Cala Blava, Llucmajor, in the Bay of Palma de Mallorca, Balearic Islands.

**Rooms & rates:** Double Rooms, Suites (including suites with a private pool), and Superior Suites with sea views, all with a private balcony; from about €758 per night.

**On-site:** Direct private beach access, outdoor pool and sundeck, free spa with hammam (treatments at a supplement), tennis courts, gym with personal training, outdoor yoga and pilates classes.

**Good to know:** The second Mallorca property in this collection, alongside Son Vida Castle, and the first former military fortress converted into a beachfront luxury hotel here — a distinctive angle compared with the rest of the collection's inland castles.

**Combine with:** Palma de Mallorca and its old town, a short drive away.
